verdict.rationale: BigQuery's own first-party docs describe in-product AI insights: Data insights automatically uncovers patterns and runs statistical analysis using generated queries, conversational analytics lets users ask natural-language questions of their data through configurable data agents, and Gemini in BigQuery suggests and explains code. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality, since all evidence is vendor documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Data insights offers an automated, intuitive way to uncover patterns and perform statistical analysis by using insightful queries that are generated from the metadata of your tables.
Conversational analytics lets you have natural language conversations with your data. You can create data agents configured with custom metadata, instructions, glossary terms, and verified queries
Conversational analytics now supports questions about market basket analysis.
Use generative AI in your workflows with AI functions for text summarization, sentiment analysis, and data enrichment.
